literal_cells: 30004021 / OWR-16635-009: Moreau (joint Arakawa), OWR 52/2018 pp.3121–3123, exact simple W-algebra isomorphism for sl7 partition (3,2,2) at −14/3 and sl4 partition (2,2) at −8/3. Original: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46773?nt=1#page=43

Tomoyuki Arakawa, Jethro van Ekeren and Anne Moreau, Singularities of nilpotent Slodowy slices and collapsing levels of W-algebras, Forum of Mathematics, Sigma 12 (2024), e95; published online 8 November 2024. Theorem 8.8(2), pp.46–48, gives the prior full affirmative answer: W_{−14/3}(sl7,f_(3,2,2))≅L_{−4/3}(sl2)≅W_{−8/3}(sl4,f_(2,2)), for simple graded quotients over C with standard Dynkin conformal vectors and c=−6. AVM explicitly credit Francesco A. Allegra for the earlier seven-dimensional example; their bibliography says 2019, while the thesis catalog records defense 11 February 2020. His unavailable thesis proof is not required by this written route. Actual affine maps, nonzero-reduction cover, self-duality/conical grading, Sugawara conditions and Theorem 3.10 are essential; equality of numerical invariants alone does not prove isomorphism. Exact orbit-closure, m=0 centralizer sl2, half-integral Dynkin roots, levels and sine data independently checked. Universal W-algebras are different; Conjecture 8.11 and a new general family are not asserted. DOI HTTP 200/Crossref identity, published PDF and arXiv:2102.13462v3 proof checked; no all 92-page or recursive foundational audit claimed. Public TeX support available; no author program executed. AI describes this internal review only, not an established source-authoring method. Existing journal result, no new upload or project-authorship/global-firstness claim.
